commands.cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys,os; d=open('docs/build_judgments.md').read(); m=re.search(r'Not closed at this close(.{0,400})',d,re.S); ids=sorted(set(re.findall(r'\b(?:BUG|TASK|DEBT)-\d{4}\b',m.group(1)))) if m else []; bad=[i for i in ids if any(re.search(r'^status: done',open(p).read(),re.M) for p in ('agenticflow/tracker/tickets/'+i+'.md','agenticflow/tracker/archive/'+i+'.md') if os.path.exists(p))]; print('doc names as not closed:',ids,'| tracker says done:',bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
